nonblocking_risks: Lowercase or noncanonical skipped statuses remain blocking, but normalized output hides original casing while preserving the blocker. Diagnostic context is reduced; required security behavior remains fail-closed.

validations.result: Diff inspected; runtime predicate uses raw fields and schema oneOf is strict

verdict.rationale: Runtime predicate evaluates raw exact values before normalization, malformed values become diagnostic nulls, and merge-readiness schema independently rejects every broader READY+SKIPPED shape. Tests cover runtime and schema positive/negative matrices.
